top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not have CPR/ First Aid in their file.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §744.605(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four out of ten staff trainings records reviewed are missing training certificates for First Aid/CPR and health/safety annual trainings.
